title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Amount of a Late-Invoice Waiver
content:
## Definition

The late-invoice waiver on a Demurrage and Detention Free Time demurrage line is the amount still open on the line less the line's dangerous-goods uplift share, which is nothing where no uplift applies. No rounding is done along the way; the difference alone is taken to the nearest cent.

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical)

| Open amount | Uplift share kept collectible | Waiver |
|---|---|---|
| 780.00 (uplift assumed at 30 percent) | 180.00 | 600.00 |
| 1000.00 (uplift assumed at 30 percent) | 230.769… | 769.23 |
| 850.00 (no uplift) | nothing | 850.00 |

**Q: After the waiver, what stays owed on the line?**
The uplift share, since the waiver leaves it outstanding; in the first row, 180.00.
